mentions.name: Fluxmail
mentions.description: This is an AI-powered email client that unifies multiple Gmail accounts into one inbox, automatically groups emails from the same sender into bundles to reduce clutter, and summarizes email threads. It also offers Gmail-style keyboard shortcuts, automatic dark-mode conversion of emails, detection and blocking of email trackers, and privacy-first handling where emails are cached locally rather than stored on servers and never used for AI training. Planned features include split inbox and AI search. Currently in early access.
mentions.problem: Dealing with multiple Gmail accounts means switching between tabs, and many emails from the same sender clutter the inbox.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a new AI-powered email client called Fluxmail: https://fluxmail.ai
